blurb: Contexts may not form a circle of `consumes` clauses, whether directly or through others. `bynk deploy` takes the order in which to upload the Workers from the `consumes` clauses, because Cloudflare resolves a Service Binding when a Worker is uploaded and so the callee must already exist; a cycle has no such order. The error names the cycle and sits on one of its clauses. Remove one clause: usually the callee takes what it needs as an argument instead of calling back. Logic both contexts need can move into a `commons` that each `uses`.
